name: embedded-clangd-gen
description: Generate compile_commands.json, .clangd, compile_flags.txt and c_cpp_properties.json from NXP S32DS, Microchip MPLAB X, STM32CubeIDE, or any Eclipse CDT Makefile project

enumDescriptions: Auto-detect from project marker files (.cproject, nbproject/, .mxproject)
NXP S32 Design Studio (Eclipse CDT, arm-none-eabi)
Microchip MPLAB X IDE (XC8 / XC16 / XC32)
Generic / Custom — uses ARM defaults, fully overridable
embeddedClangd.ideType.description: Which IDE generated this project. 'auto' detects from project files and prompts if ambiguous.

embeddedClangd.projectRoot.description: Project root directory. Leave empty to auto-detect: walks up from the active editor file looking for .cproject / nbproject / .mxproject / .git, then falls back to the first workspace folder.

embeddedClangd.compilerPath.markdownDescription:
Absolute path to the compiler executable. clangd runs it with `-v` to extract system include paths.

- **S32DS**: `C:/NXP/S32DS.3.5/.../arm-none-eabi-gcc.exe`
- **MPLAB XC32**: `C:/Program Files/Microchip/xc32/v4.30/bin/xc32-gcc.exe`
- **STM32CubeIDE**: `C:/ST/STM32CubeIDE_1.14.0/.../arm-none-eabi-gcc.exe`

embeddedClangd.makePath.description: Path to make executable. Leave empty to use 'make' from PATH. Full path required if IDE bundles its own make (common on Windows).

embeddedClangd.buildFolders.markdownDescription:
Build output folder names to search for Makefiles, tried in order. **Leave empty to use the IDE preset defaults.**

- S32DS default: `["Debug_FLASH", "Debug_RAM", "Release_FLASH", ...]`
- MPLAB default: `["dist/default/production", "dist/default/debug", ...]`
- STM32 default: `["Debug", "Release"]`

embeddedClangd.targetTriple.description: Compiler target triple. Leave empty to use IDE preset (arm-none-eabi for S32DS/STM32, mipsel-unknown-elf for MPLAB XC32). Override for XC8: pic-unknown-elf, XC16: pic30-unknown-elf.

embeddedClangd.cpuFlags.markdownDescription:
CPU-specific flags re-added after stripping. **Leave empty to use IDE preset.**

Examples:
- Cortex-M4 FPU: `["-mcpu=cortex-m4","-mthumb","-mfpu=fpv4-sp-d16","-mfloat-abi=hard"]`
- Cortex-M33: `["-mcpu=cortex-m33","-mthumb","-mfpu=fpv5-sp-d16","-mfloat-abi=hard"]`
- Cortex-M0+: `["-mcpu=cortex-m0plus","-mthumb"]`

embeddedClangd.stripFlags.description: Flag patterns (glob * wildcard) to strip before passing to clangd. Leave empty to use IDE preset. Add IDE-specific flags clangd rejects here.

embeddedClangd.extraIncludes.description: Additional include paths added to every config on top of what the build system provides. e.g. ["C:/FreeRTOS/include", "C:/SDK/platform/include"]

embeddedClangd.extraDefines.description: Additional preprocessor defines added to every config. e.g. ["DEBUG", "CPU_S32K144HFT0VLLT", "USE_HAL_DRIVER"]

embeddedClangd.cStandard.description: C standard. Leave empty to use IDE preset (c11 for S32DS/STM32, c99 for MPLAB).

embeddedClangd.generateCompileFlags.description: Also generate compile_flags.txt as a fallback for tools that don't read compile_commands.json.

embeddedClangd.backgroundIndex.description: Enable clangd background indexing (.clangd Index.Background setting).
